_comment: Plain-language text for every action Intelligence can propose or take, keyed by action type. The code (ActionProvider in each unit's action_providers.py) holds the title, description, who must approve (permission) and whether it may run automatically. tests/test_check_catalog.py fails if an action has no entry here, or an entry has no action.

_permissions.po.create: Someone allowed to create purchase requests for that branch
_permissions.prices.manage: Someone allowed to change selling prices
_permissions.receivables.manage: Someone allowed to manage what customers owe (for example a branch manager or an accountant)
_permissions.customers.manage: Someone allowed to change customers' credit
_permissions.findings.manage: Someone allowed to manage alerts (for example the owner or a finance manager)

purchasing.draft_purchase_request.plain: When a product has run out or is low at a branch, Ziira writes a draft purchase request: enough to get back to your reorder level or cover a month of sales, whichever is more. Your usual suppliers are noted on it. Nothing is ordered until a person sends it.
purchasing.draft_purchase_request.example: Cement is out of stock at Branch A. Ziira drafts a request for 120 bags and notes the two suppliers you buy from most.

purchasing.propose_price_update.plain: When a supplier raises a cost and your margin shrinks, Ziira works out a new selling price that gives the new cost the same margin the old cost had. It takes effect from tomorrow, and only after a person approves.
purchasing.propose_price_update.example: Cement now costs 17% more. Ziira proposes raising the price from 850 to 975 so the margin stays at 12%.

pos.send_payment_reminder.plain: Sends your usual payment reminder to a customer who is late, about their oldest overdue invoices (at most three). Customers who asked not to be contacted are never messaged.
pos.send_payment_reminder.example: Customer A is 45 days late on two invoices. A reminder goes out by SMS or email, the way you normally remind customers.

pos.hold_credit.plain: Lowers a late customer's credit limit to what they already owe, so nothing more can be sold to them on account until they pay. It always needs a person, because credit is money.
pos.hold_credit.example: Customer C is 60 days late. Ziira proposes dropping the limit from 200,000 to the 150,000 they owe.

people.nudge_approver.plain: Reminds the person who can decide that a leave request or a payroll run has been waiting too long. It sends a short message and decides nothing.
people.nudge_approver.example: A leave request has waited 8 days. The branch's approver gets a reminder.

finance.ask_for_reconciliation.plain: Asks the people who can reconcile the bank to finish a reconciliation that has been open too long.
finance.ask_for_reconciliation.example: The main account's reconciliation has been open 41 days. The finance team gets a reminder.

intel.nudge_exceptions_reviewers.plain: Reminds the people who work through the exceptions inbox that items have been waiting too long.
intel.nudge_exceptions_reviewers.example: 11 items have waited more than a week. The reviewers get a reminder.

_ask_tools.command_figures: Your key figures for a period (sales, voids, refunds, stock value, overdue balances), compared with the period before, for the business and by branch.
_ask_tools.crm_customer_balance: What a named customer owes, how much of it is late, and their credit limit.
_ask_tools.crm_overdue_customers: Customers who are late paying, the biggest amount first.
_ask_tools.finance_profit_and_loss: Income, cost of sales, profit and expenses between two dates, from your books.
_ask_tools.finance_cash_position: Cash, bank and mobile-money balances, and what moved them.
_ask_tools.intel_list_findings: The alerts you are allowed to see, the most serious first.
_ask_tools.intel_finding_detail: One alert in full: the facts, the figures and the records behind it.
_ask_tools.inventory_stock_on_hand: How much of a product is in stock at each branch you can see.
_ask_tools.inventory_low_stock: Products at or below their reorder level, the most short first.
_ask_tools.people_headcount: How many employees are active, on leave or have left, by branch.
_ask_tools.people_leave_pending: Leave requests waiting for a decision.
_ask_tools.pos_sales_summary: How many sales and their total between two dates, and how many were cancelled, by branch or by day.
_ask_tools.pos_top_products: Your best-selling products between two dates.
_ask_tools.pos_voids: Cancelled sales between two dates: how many, their value and the latest.
_ask_tools.purchasing_supplier_balance: What you owe a named supplier and how much of it is late.
_ask_tools.purchasing_bills_due: Supplier bills that are late or due soon, the earliest first.
